Speak to go live

Your voice only goes to the speaker when it’s clearly louder than what the speaker itself puts into the mic. If feedback starts, that exact frequency is filtered out automatically (and the volume comes down only if that isn’t enough). With a Bluetooth speaker, pick this device’s own microphone above: using a Bluetooth headset’s mic drops it to low-quality call mode. Wired output has the least delay. While the mic is on, your phone’s volume buttons may control a separate “call” volume: press volume up if it’s still quiet.

    Buttons and sounds are saved on this device only. Tap a button to play it; tap again to restart. Hold off on huge files: a few seconds of audio works best.

    Built-in recordings are public domain (CC0): from Freesound via the OpenXLR starter pack, the EternityForest Free-SFX collection, the wyzowl SFX Kit, and Freesound farts by BipolarBad and SoundGod77 via rochasaurus-rex. The police siren and steamboat whistle are generated.
